tools.name: daygrid_get_context
tools.title: Get calendar context
tools.description: Start here. Returns today's date, weekday, calendar timezone, calendar_generation (required by every write), colors, limits and the approval mode.

data.description: today, weekday, week_starts_on, calendar_timezone, calendar_generation, supported_date_range, max_query_days, max_page_size, colors, change_sequence, approval_mode, service_version

tools.name: daygrid_month_overview
tools.title: Overview of busy days
tools.description: Per-day counts (planned/done) and colors for a date range of at most 366 days. Cheap way to see which days have items before listing them.

tools.name: daygrid_list_items
tools.title: List items in a date range
tools.description: List items within an inclusive date range of at most 366 days, optionally filtered by text, color or status. Paged: follow next_cursor until it is null.
